title: Opus 5.5 Did the Same Job for 27 Cents #shorts
title_alternatives: Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: The Cheap One Skipped This #shorts
description:
Same job, two Claude models: Opus 5 charged $1.45, Opus 5.5 charged 27 cents. Both passed 18/18 hidden tests.

Full test (6 min): https://youtu.be/3RbuOZYm-ck

Costs are API-equivalent from Claude Code's own logs; we ran it on a subscription. One run per model, default settings, not a benchmark.

Made with AI tools; stories based on a real AI-agent company.
